# Architectural layer of every workspace crate.
#
#   package | layer | graph
#
# The product graph holds the eight inward crates; the support graph holds the
# two crates that exist for tests and repository policy.
slingshot-agent-connection|adapter|product
slingshot-agent-protocol|contract|product
slingshot-command-line|entry|product
slingshot-configuration|contract|product
slingshot-daemon|service|product
slingshot-development|tooling|support
slingshot-domain|domain|product
slingshot-local-protocol|contract|product
slingshot-storage|adapter|product
slingshot-test-support|support|support
